description.value: Megabite Pizza is a BC-based pizza franchise chain with outlets across the Greater Vancouver area. The menu spans pizzas, wings, poutine, chicken rolls, cheese sticks, and beverages, providing a substantial calorie stop for cyclists. Catering orders can be placed online for group rides or events.
